data.name: T'Dorn
data.description:

T'Dorn often wears mechanic's coveralls, which hug her curves to accentuate their size, but oftentimes she's stained with oil, sweat or who knows what else.

T'Dorn is used to using her hands, and so she gives legendary handjobs, as well as being able to finger herself, and any men to a state of absolute bliss.
